name: Eli Mohanty/ ଏଲି ମହାନ୍ତି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Eli Mohanty’s ‘ମାଟି ରଂଗର ଭୋକ’, published in Kabita Live’s July 2024 edition, places hunger at the centre of a restless, questioning landscape. Earth, grain, a chariot wheel and the body recur as the speaker moves between material need and the language of ritual.

The poem’s images widen from the field to the cosmos, but keep returning to the hungry body. Its questions resist easy consolation: myth and prayer remain answerable to the need for food. This is a reading of the poem’s concerns, rather than an account of the poet’s personal life.
